name: UniProtKB (Swiss-Prot and TrEMBL)
scope: Protein sequences with curated function, domains, variants, PTMs and cross-references. 20,431 reviewed (Swiss-Prot) human entries.
formats: flat files and FASTA on FTP
mapping_methods: Cross-references to Ensembl, RefSeq, HGNC, PDB and AlphaFold DB.

quantitative.summary: Mostly categorical annotation; curated variant effects as text.

coverage_limitations: Variant sections are not systematic experimental measurements

reuse_decision.rationale: Primary source; fetch the reviewed human table with identifier cross-references (needed to join protein-level MaveDB targets to genes and structures).
